name: HEALTHBANE - Master IOC database
description: Consolidated IOC database for the HEALTHBANE campaign against MedDefense Health Systems. Combines indicators from 4x00 phishing dissection, 4x01 network forensics, 4x02 intelligence analysis, 4x03 malware triage and 4x04 threat hunt. This file is the reference baseline used by 4x05 attack reconstruction to classify newly-discovered indicators as KNOWN / NEW / MODIFIED.

evidence_paths: 4x00 email batch (subject: Update your MedDefense portal password)
WHOIS: registered 2026-04-12 (2 days before campaign), Namecheap, privacy-protected
iocs.notes: Lookalike of meddefense-portal.meddefense.local (the legitimate internal portal). Hosted Office 365 credential harvesting page. 3 emails referencing this domain confirmed in 4x00.

evidence_paths: 4x02 HC3 advisory listing as campaign infrastructure
iocs.notes: Root domain of HEALTHBANE infrastructure. Two subdomains observed (HB-IOC-0005, HB-IOC-0006). Domain registered 2026-03-09 (5 weeks before campaign launch).
Primary C2 beacon endpoint. 5-minute heartbeat. RC4-wrapped JSON over TLS 1.2. Resolves to HB-IOC-0008.

DNS-tunnel exfiltration channel. Used at HEALTHBANE partner victims for data egress (Stage 3). Observed but not exercised against MedDefense in 4x04 (no large-volume queries seen yet -- exfil interrupted by hunt). Resolves to HB-IOC-0009.
Payload-distribution path on the same C2 infrastructure. Used during Stage 2 dropper -> RAT delivery. Not observed beyond 2026-04-21 at MedDefense (RAT already deployed).

iocs.notes: Resolves from HB-IOC-0005 (sync.healthbane-c2.net). ASN 60781 (LeaseWeb DE), known bulletproof reseller. Consistent across whole campaign window.
